title: Form
description: The Form layer of an envelope: one way the thing can be seen (a splat, a scan, photographs, a painting, a reconstruction), how it was captured, and how directly it records the thing. Basis is shown with every form, so a visitor can tell a record of the object from something that only stands for it.

of.description: Envelope id or character id this form shows.

kind.description: What the form is. splat/scan/photo/photo-series/video are captures; painting/drawing/diorama are made by a person; reconstruction is generated.

basis.description: recorded: captured from the object itself, so what is shown was there (photographs, scans, splats). interpreted: made by a person from looking or from sources (paintings, drawings, the 1971 diorama itself). symbolic: generated; it stands for the object but is not a record of it (AI reconstructions).

coverage.description: How much of the object the capture saw. A recorded form can still miss sides.

label.description: Short name shown with the basis badge.

count.description: Number of photographs or frames, for photo-series and video.

derivedFrom.description: Form ids this one was made from.

unseen.description: What the form shows that was never captured (e.g. an invented front).

src.description: File to display, relative to src/index.html. Omitted when the form is held but not published.

published.description: False when the material is held as a source but not shown (rights not yet cleared).
